data.title: Mastering Multi-Morpheme Words

targets.hint: What word means directions or teaching given to help someone learn?
targets.definition: Teaching or directions that explain how to do something.
targets.sentenceContext: The teacher gave clear ___ before we started the science experiment.

targets.hint: What word describes something that is easy to guess before it happens?
targets.definition: Able to be known or declared ahead of time.
targets.sentenceContext: The movie ending was so ___ that everyone guessed it right away.

targets.hint: What word describes an object that can easily be carried across places?
targets.definition: Capable of being moved or carried from one place to another.
targets.sentenceContext: Foldable camping chairs are light and easily ___.

targets.hint: What word means a break or stop in what someone is saying or doing?
targets.definition: The act of breaking into or stopping an ongoing action.
targets.sentenceContext: The loud bell caused an unexpected ___ during reading time.

data.gradeLevel: elementary students (grades 1-5) - Use age-appropriate vocabulary, concrete examples, structured learning objectives, and interactive elements. Build fundamental understanding.
